page.overview:
What is Haddonfield General Hospital?

Haddonfield General Hospital was located in Haddonfield, Illinois. On October 31, 2007, the hospital had to take care of Laurie Strode, Annie Brackett and Dr. Sam Loomis. All three had suffered Michael Myers' attacks that night.

Category:Locations Category:Halloween II (2009)
